template: On the currently open dashboard '{{v1}}', set the auto-refresh interval to 1 minute and PERSIST it. Steps: open the time picker in the top bar, find the 'Refresh interval' / 'Auto refresh' section, select '1m' (1 minute) as the refresh interval, and close the picker. Then click '{{v3}}' and confirm Save in the dialog (tick 'Update default time range' if it is offered, to be safe). Verify a 'Dashboard saved' confirmation appears. Then do a full page reload of the dashboard URL WITHOUT time parameters ({{v6}}) and report what the top-bar time picker shows for the refresh interval after the reload (it should show '1m' or 'refreshing every 1m'), plus the time range shown. Report the refresh interval before and after the reload.

reportTemplate.summary: Set auto-refresh to 1 minute via the top-bar refresh picker (1m) and persisted it. Because this build shows no {{v3}} button in view mode, I clicked 'Edit' to enter edit mode, then {{v3}}; the dialog reported 'No changes to save' until I ticked the offered 'Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default' checkbox (no 'Update default time range' checkbox was offered, as only the refresh value differed), which enabled Save; after clicking Save the 'Dashboard saved' status alert appeared. Verified with a full reload of /d/{{v4}}/{{v5}} with no time parameters: the refresh interval button now reads '1m' (aria-label '...current interval 1 minute selected') and the time picker reads 'Last 6 hours'. Refresh interval before: Off ("Auto refresh turned off"); after reload: 1m.
